days.description: Getting there: Take the Limousine bus from Hanoi to Ninh Binh (2 hours, 120,000–150,000 VND / ~$5–6). Buses depart from Giáp Bát bus station or pick up from the Old Quarter. Alternatively, train from Hanoi Station (2.5h, from 75,000 VND). This works as a day trip or overnight — we recommend a day trip to keep moving south.
